run_xm3600_evaluation: run the XM3600 multilingual image-text retrieval evaluation on a CLIP model and save results to JSON
evaluate_image_text_retrieval: evaluate image-to-text and text-to-image recall@1 across 36 locales using a vision-language model
parse_xm3600_results: parse a saved XM3600 evaluation JSON file and extract average text-to-image and image-to-text scores
encode_images_batched: encode a directory of JPEG images into normalized feature vectors using a CLIP model in batches of 128
encode_captions_multilingual: encode multilingual captions from a JSONL file into normalized text features using a tokenizer and CLIP model
